lede: The day's one real cross-feed story is a security one: a cyberattack reached the refrigeration systems of supermarkets across Europe, forcing freezers into automatic defrost cycles and, by the reporting, disrupting deliveries and prices. It surfaced on Hacker News and Lemmy at the same time, the only item today to land on two feeds at once. Elsewhere attention scattered: Wikipedia's most-read article pulled more than 1.4 million views in a day, and on Steam, Counter-Strike 2 held over 1.2 million players at once.

throughlines.title: Hackers activate automatic defrosting in supermarket fridges across Europe
throughlines.gist: A cyberattack hit supermarket refrigeration across Europe, triggering automatic defrost cycles and, per the reports, touching deliveries and prices; it was the only story today to cross two feeds.

throughlines.title: RJ Mitte
throughlines.gist: RJ Mitte was the most-read article on Wikipedia today at just over 1.4 million views, roughly six times the next name on the list.

throughlines.title: morluto/rea
throughlines.gist: morluto/rea topped GitHub trending with about 45,300 new stars in a day, more than a quarter of its all-time total, a sign of a sharp recent surge.
